body:
I was talking to somebody online about buying powder DXM for the first time as DXM is my all time favourite chemical.  They told me they'd throw in some AMT and TFMPP for cheap.
So it all came in and I ingested about 20 some mg of TFMPP and maybe like 30 mg of AMT.  'This is weak' I said after about 3 hours.  Very few interesting things happened, but the most notable was staring at myself in the mirror wondering who exactly I was.
Keep in mind that I am *not* a responsible drug user and this was not a responsible thing to do :
I cut out like 15 mg of TFMPP and 20 or so mg of AMT in a spoon, cooked it and shot it in the back of my left arm.  My teeth chattered and my pupils dilated within 10 minutes.  I couldn't concentrate and I thought I was very ugly.  It actually felt more like a heavy-body meth or almost even crack hit than any kind of psychadelic.
All in all, I became caveman.  I regressed ('Altered States').  Imagine a drug crazed maniac crawling around his 2 bedroom townhouse by himself screaming 'Where's the pot?!  I need to calm the fuck down!'  That was my experience.
Nothing spiritual, nothing too incredible...these drugs suck.  And for the record, powder DXM wasn't too great either.  I think I'll stick with good ol' TUSSIN!
